name: AI Deep Dive — IREN — 2026-05-02
rationale: IREN (formerly Iris Energy) has achieved a $15.1B valuation on the promise of its dual Bitcoin/HPC data center model. Growth is strong (59%), but free cash flow burn is severe (-$1.12B TTM). However, analysts forecast explosive revenue acceleration toward $2.8B by 2027. Unlike pure crypto miners, IREN's HPC optionality provides a potential path to sustainable high margins. Weighted fair value of $50.38 implies a mild 10% upside, but the dilution risk required to fund their gigawatt pipeline makes it a HOLD.

aiThesis.rationale: IREN is executing a massive infrastructure expansion, pivoting its Bitcoin mining operations into AI and High-Performance Computing (HPC) hosting. The execution so far has been aggressive, resulting in a staggering -$1.12B in free cash flow over the last 12 months. To fund this at a $15B market cap, current shareholders will face significant equity dilution (modeled at 35% in the base case). However, if analyst projections for 2027 ($2.8B+ revenue) materialize, the terminal cash flows from the HPC hosting transition can overpower the dilution effect. The current $45.66 valuation is stretched, making it a HOLD as execution risks remain high.
